# Liberated Bread DNS blocklist: profile 'updates', device 'lg-webos', format 'pihole'
# Generated from cloud.egress in https://github.com/liberatedbread/liberatedbread-protocol-specs
# by scripts/generate_blocklists.py. Do not edit this file; fix the spec.
#
# Firmware update hosts only, so the rest of the vendor cloud, and the vendor app away
# from home, usually keeps working; where a device's update offer rides its main cloud
# link, that link is listed too. It stops the update hosts the specs NAME; vendors move
# update traffic without notice, so this is the weakest list here.
#
# A DNS list is the second layer. A device that ignores your resolver walks
# straight past it, so firewall the device as well: https://liberatedbread.com/firewall/
#
# Add as an adlist (Pi-hole FTL 5.22+ or v6 for the ||name^ lines). An adlist can only
# block, and what a blocked name answers is your Pi-hole's blocking mode, not this file.
# It cannot redirect: for the time sources below, add each as a local DNS record (v6:
# dns.hosts; v5: Local DNS > DNS Records) pointing at your NTP server.
#
# Devices:
#   LG webOS TV Second Screen Protocol (lg-webos)
#
# Left out, because blocking them breaks the device or its clock:
#   - lgtvsdp.com (lg-webos): The TV takes its clock from this service — a header on its
#     HTTPS API rather than NTP — and the Content Store, app updates and home-screen
#     configuration live here too. Blocked, the clock resets after a cold boot (to
#     2019-12-31 on one report) and apps then fail their certificate checks.
#   - nextlgsdp.com (lg-webos): The newer SDP family: blocking it is reported to stop
#     the TV setting its clock and to disable the Content Store.
#
# Each rule below is preceded by: devices | roles | verification.
# 'reported' and 'hypothesis' entries have not been observed by this project.

# lg-webos | firmware_check | hypothesis
nsu.lge.com
# lg-webos | firmware_check | reported
snu.lge.com
# lg-webos | firmware_check | reported
su-dev.lge.com
# lg-webos | firmware_download | reported
su-ssl.lge.com
# lg-webos | firmware_download | reported
su.lge.com
